verdict.rationale: Vestd advertises an HRIS integration page ('Connect your HR platform to Vestd and end the manual data shuffle') suggesting some sync capability, but there's no detail on which HRIS platforms (Gusto, Rippling, etc.) are supported, how new hires/terminations flow into equity records, or whether this is automatic vs. manual import. missing for 10: named HRIS platform integrations (Gusto, Rippling), specifics on automated new-hire/termination sync into equity records, independent/hands-on confirmation of the integration working.
